## Helper function (temporary for debug)
```{r}
get_google_duration <- function(origin_lat, origin_lon,
                                dest_lat, dest_lon,
                                mode = c("bicycling", "transit"),
                                departure_time = NULL,
                                api_key = Sys.getenv("GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY")) {

  mode <- match.arg(mode)

  if (api_key == "") {
    warning("GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY is empty inside R – directions calls will fail.")
  }

  base_url <- "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/directions/json"

  if (is.null(departure_time)) {
    departure_unix <- as.integer(Sys.time())
  } else {
    departure_unix <- as.integer(as.POSIXct(departure_time, tz = "UTC"))
  }

  q <- list(
    origin      = sprintf("%f,%f", origin_lat, origin_lon),
    destination = sprintf("%f,%f", dest_lat, dest_lon),
    mode        = mode,
    key         = api_key
  )
  if (mode == "transit") q$departure_time <- departure_unix

  out <- tryCatch({
    res  <- GET(base_url, query = q)
    cont <- fromJSON(content(res, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))

    status <- if (is.null(cont$status)) NA_character_ else cont$status
    err    <- if (is.null(cont$error_message)) NA_character_ else cont$error_message

    if (status != "OK" || length(cont$routes) == 0) {
      return(tibble(
        duration_min  = NA_real_,
        route_summary = NA_character_,
        status        = status,
        error_message = err
      ))
    }

    leg <- cont$routes[[1]]$legs[[1]]
    duration_min <- leg$duration$value / 60

    route_summary <- NA_character_
    if (mode == "transit") {
      steps <- leg$steps
      if (!is.null(steps$transit_details)) {
        short_names <- steps$transit_details$line$short_name
        short_names <- short_names[!is.na(short_names)]
        if (length(short_names) > 0) {
          route_summary <- paste(unique(short_names), collapse = " + ")
        }
      }
    }

    tibble(
      duration_min  = duration_min,
      route_summary = route_summary,
      status        = status,
      error_message = err
    )

  }, error = function(e) {
    tibble(
      duration_min  = NA_real_,
      route_summary = NA_character_,
      status        = NA_character_,
      error_message = as.character(e$message)
    )
  })

  out
}
```


## Call google for each sampled trip
```{r}
TYPICAL_TIME <- "2025-06-04 08:00:00"

google_results <- sample_trips %>%
  mutate(
    bike_res = purrr::pmap(
      list(start_lat, start_lon, end_lat, end_lon),
      ~ get_google_duration(..1, ..2, ..3, ..4,
                            mode   = "bicycling")
    ),
    transit_res = purrr::pmap(
      list(start_lat, start_lon, end_lat, end_lon),
      ~ get_google_duration(..1, ..2, ..3, ..4,
                            mode          = "transit",
                            departure_time = TYPICAL_TIME)
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest_wider(bike_res,    names_sep = "_") %>%
  tidyr::unnest_wider(transit_res, names_sep = "_") %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    bike_min              = bike_res_duration_min,
    bike_status           = bike_res_status,
    bike_error            = bike_res_error_message,
    transit_min           = transit_res_duration_min,
    transit_route_summary = transit_res_route_summary,
    transit_status        = transit_res_status,
    transit_error         = transit_res_error_message
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    diff_bike_vs_transit  = bike_min   - transit_min,
    diff_transit_vs_micro = transit_min - duration_micro_min,
    diff_bike_vs_micro    = bike_min   - duration_micro_min
  )
```

```{r}
names(google_results)
```

```{r}
table(google_results$transit_status, useNA = "ifany")
head(google_results %>%
       select(trip_id, bike_min, transit_min,
              duration_micro_min, bike_status, transit_status,
              transit_route_summary))
```

## Filter for only successful results
```{r}
google_success <- google_results %>%
  filter(
    bike_status    == "OK",
    transit_status == "OK",
    is.finite(bike_min),
    is.finite(transit_min)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_transit_vs_micro = transit_min - duration_micro_min,
    diff_bike_vs_micro    = bike_min    - duration_micro_min,
    diff_bike_vs_transit  = bike_min    - transit_min
  )

nrow(google_success)
```

## Summary
```{r}
summary_overall <- google_success %>%
  summarise(
    n_trips = n(),
    
    mean_micro_min   = mean(duration_micro_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bike_min    = mean(bike_min,            na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_transit_min = mean(transit_min,         na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_diff_transit_minus_micro = mean(diff_transit_vs_micro, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff_bike_minus_micro    = mean(diff_bike_vs_micro,    na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff_bike_minus_transit  = mean(diff_bike_vs_transit,  na.rm = TRUE)
  )

summary_overall
```

```{r}
summary_by_route <- google_success %>%
  group_by(transit_route_summary) %>%
  summarise(
    n_trips = n(),
    mean_micro_min   = mean(duration_micro_min,   na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_transit_min = mean(transit_min,          na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_diff_transit_minus_micro = mean(diff_transit_vs_micro, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_trips))

summary_by_route
```

## Debug
```{r}
debug_google_call <- function(origin_lat, origin_lon,
                              dest_lat, dest_lon,
                              mode = c("bicycling", "transit"),
                              departure_time = NULL,
                              api_key) {

  mode <- match.arg(mode)

  if (is.null(departure_time)) {
    departure_unix <- as.integer(Sys.time())
  } else {
    departure_unix <- as.integer(as.POSIXct(departure_time, tz = "UTC"))
  }

  base_url <- "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/directions/json"

  q <- list(
    origin      = sprintf("%f,%f", origin_lat, origin_lon),
    destination = sprintf("%f,%f", dest_lat,  dest_lon),
    mode        = mode,
    key         = api_key
  )
  if (mode == "transit") q$departure_time <- departure_unix

  full_url <- modify_url(base_url, query = q)
  cat("DEBUG URL (copy into browser):\n", full_url, "\n\n")

  res  <- GET(full_url)
  txt  <- content(res, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  cont <- fromJSON(txt)

  status <- cont$status
  err    <- cont$error_message %||% NA_character_

  duration_min <- if (identical(status, "OK")) {
    cont$routes[[1]]$legs[[1]]$duration$value / 60
  } else NA_real_

  tibble(
    duration_min  = duration_min,
    route_summary = NA_character_,
    status        = status,
    error_message = err
  )
}
```

```{r}
test_debug <- debug_google_call(
  origin_lat = 44.9778,   # downtown mnpls
  origin_lon = -93.2650,
  dest_lat   = 44.9733,   # umn east bank-ish area
  dest_lon   = -93.2260,
  mode       = "transit",
  departure_time = "2025-06-04 08:00:00",
  api_key    = "()"
)
```
